title: CPP-5: Replace raw CloseHandle/new/delete with WIL/std RAII in hotspots

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The isolated exact-head local checkout and thirteen-path patch parity remain prepared. The pinned libwebp baseline resolves to the installed port recipe, but that does not establish shared binary ABI compatibility. The isolated native installation is still absent. Both cached CppWinRT/WIL NuGet archives match adjacent sidecar hashes but conflict with their NuGet metadata content hashes, so they must not be reused as trusted packages. NuGet CLI availability and approved isolated dependency provisioning remain unresolved prerequisites. No dependency staging, restore, build or test ran; full review remains incomplete.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
